name: Track dragged token movement and automatically commit Boost actions

operations.replace:
this.movement = {
      maximum: this.speed,
      spent: 0,
      remaining: this.speed,
      completed: false,
      totalTracked: 0,
      standardUsed: 0,
      boostUsed: 0,
      overchargeBoostUsed: 0,
      excess: 0,
      segments: [],
      processedMovementIds: []
    };

Speed ${movement.maximum}
Total Moved ${movement.totalTracked ?? movement.spent}
Current Allowance ${movement.remaining}
Standard ${movement.standardUsed ?? 0} / ${movement.maximum}
Boost ${movement.boostUsed ?? 0} / ${movement.maximum}
OC Boost ${movement.overchargeBoostUsed ?? 0} / ${movement.maximum}
Excess ${movement.excess ?? 0}
